deviations.deviation: EdwinPAI gateway bundled as npm dependency instead of git submodule
deviations.rationale: Simpler dependency management, version pinning via package.json, faster CI builds
deviations.impact: Low - gateway can still be updated independently via npm version bump

deviations.deviation: Chat history stored in localStorage instead of ~/.edwinpai/chat_history.json
deviations.rationale: Simpler implementation, no Tauri fs permission needed, 10MB localStorage limit sufficient for ~1000 messages
deviations.impact: Low - can migrate to file-based storage in Phase 6 if needed

deviations.deviation: mDNS uses mdns-sd crate instead of Tauri plugin
deviations.rationale: No official Tauri mDNS plugin, mdns-sd is well-maintained and cross-platform
deviations.impact: None - mdns-sd handles all 3 platforms correctly
